releases.notes: Windows only: correct Outlook attachment filenames for plain-text and HTML drafts across local, inline and chunked upload routes. Six live cases verified exact filename, PDF MIME and bytes using the freshly rebuilt packaged helper. Temporary drafts deleted; no sends. Invalid filenames rejected before attachment mutation. Unsigned preview; installation, upgrade and customer acceptance separate. Mac/Linux unchanged.

Windows only: attach known local files to Outlook drafts without base64 in agent calls. Opt-in local-file permission and current draft version required. Native Windows, packaged app and8MiB exact-byte draft attachment checks passed. Unsigned preview; installation/automatic upgrade and customer acceptance separate. Mac/Linux unchanged.

Independent signed CLI, Outlook and agent plugin updates, browser recovery and Outlook Unicode fixes. Native Windows/Linux/Intel/Apple Silicon qualification passed. Windows unsigned; Macs signed and notarized. Preview; live email and automatic-upgrade acceptance not claimed.

Apple Silicon Companion beta.38: native ARM64 build and qualification, cloud-managed app settings and merged compatibility/status fixes. Developer ID signed, Apple notarized and stapled. Intel Mac stays beta.36; Linux and Windows stay beta.37. Preview; no installed-app replacement, fresh provider sign-in, real Outlook send or automatic-upgrade-cycle acceptance.

Companion beta.37 for Linux and Windows: cloud-managed plugin settings and human-approval-bound Outlook sends. Mac downloads remain beta.36. Windows unsigned preview; Debian extracted payload qualified, no new installer/upgrade cycle or live approval-send acceptance.

Codex and Claude local agent SDK/helper and connection flow; canonical task session transport; Windows first-start credential durability. Signed/notarized Intel Mac, unsigned Windows preview. No ARM build, automatic inbox injection or default cloud MCP discovery. Existing recommended versions and updater feeds unchanged.

notes: Fixes false startup damage errors using existing loading, adds on-demand support liveness, Classic Outlook draft-only plugin, personal CLI and black icon assets. Signed/notarized Mac; unsigned Windows preview. See RELEASE-VERIFICATION.md for exact platform and updater acceptance limits.

Corrects missing bundled private-network helpers on clean release runners. Both helpers, licenses and provenance are packaged and checked. Preserves existing caching, default management and hidden Computer Pass changes. macOS is signed, notarized and stapled; Windows remains unsigned preview. Native CI covers packaged startup and helper lifecycle; live-account enrollment and user-machine acceptance remain unperformed. Preview only; no stable or fleet promotion.

Five-minute bounded Browser Pass inventory caching and companion cloud polling reduce Firestore reads while keeping execution and authorization live. Remote app management is enabled for signed-in installations; legacy Computer Pass UI/service resources are removed. Chrome Store extension 0.1.29 remains compatible. Both macOS architectures are Developer ID signed, notarized and stapled. Windows remains an unsigned preview. Preview only; no stable or fleet promotion.

Computer Pass model-compatible bounded capture and target lifetime on Mac, Windows and Linux, retaining authority, focus, geometry and Stop checks. Real production Talk model typing and independent Mac fixture readback passed. Installed Windows beta19 native fixture tests passed. Regular Sym chat attachment works but execution qualification remains pending and is not claimed by this native preview. Windows unsigned. Preview only; no stable or fleet promotion.

Linux updater: use an existing exact-command sudo authorization noninteractively, otherwise preserve the native polkit dialog. Distinguish cancellation, authorization failure, timeout and package errors; never collect passwords or repair unrelated packages. Mac/Windows downloads unchanged. Preview only.

Linux X11 Computer Pass: bind missing logind Display using kernel X-server peer credentials and exact logind session, preserving active/lock/user checks. Includes beta15 truthful permission refresh on all platforms. Live Linux screenshot, clicking, typing, shortcut, drag, scroll and native Stop passed. Mac/Windows native implementations unchanged from live-tested beta15. Windows unsigned. Preview only, no stable/fleet promotion.

Mac/Windows permission-status repair: refresh actual Computer Pass readiness automatically and stop reporting missing permissions after they are granted. Screenshot, coordinate click and focused typing native implementations unchanged from beta14. Linux remains at beta14 and was not tested for this release. Windows is unsigned. No stable or fleet promotion.

Screenshot-first optional Computer Pass preview. Linux capture lifecycle repaired and tested through actual AppImage/Debian upgrades, real compositor input and 768 repeated captures. Mac packages are signed, notarized and stapled. Windows is unsigned. Windows recipient-account/physical Stop and Linux production portal chooser acceptance remain unverified; CI fixture consent is not human consent. Computer Pass remains opt-in with local OS permission. No stable promotion or fleet activation.

Linux Computer Pass consent now checks native capability before offering Control and reserves a working emergency-stop shortcut with safe alternatives. Observe remains available when shortcut registration is unavailable. Broad Computer Control remains unqualified and is not enabled. Real packaged X11 shortcut-conflict, emergency-stop and beta.12-to-beta.13 installed upgrade tests passed for AppImage and Debian, with encrypted synthetic state retained. Mac/Windows packages and stable selection are unchanged.

Sym branding and first-party in-app updates on all five packages. Real installed beta.12-to-QA-successor upgrades passed with retained OS-encrypted synthetic data, integrity rejection and Debian authorization denial/recovery. Mac apps are signed, notarized and stapled; Windows remains an unsigned preview. Display targets are Observe-only. Unqualified broad Computer Control, Wayland paths and an independent second cursor remain outside this release. Older installations may need one final manual install; no automatic migration of existing customers is claimed.
All public URLs and updater metadata are first-party. Only the separately reviewed approval commit advances preview selection; stable is unchanged.

Includes shipped embedded-networking and Windows beta10 fixes; unfinished native Computer Pass Control is not enabled.
